text:
elaine: Heads-up — incoming pentest next month. We need to lock down ops for the assessment: RBAC minimal roles, KMS access questions, audit log retention, and a concrete retest window. Can we do a quick plan here?
sam: timeline? who is the assessor?
elaine: External engagement starts 2026-05-10, AcmeSec. Dry-run one week prior.
marta: For RBAC, recommend two ephemeral roles: assessor-readonly and assessor-network. assessor-readonly = read-only to logs and S3 evidence bucket, no secrets access. assessor-network allows limited egress to staging.
tim: Agree. How do we handle KMS? They asked for sample encrypted artifacts and to verify key wrapping.
nashley: We should create a customer-managed key (CMK) with grant tokens for the assessor's short-lived role. No direct KMS console access. Provide decrypt grant only for the evidence bundle during the window.
carlos: Ops note — need KMS policy snippets. I can paste a minimal grant example:\n\n```\n{\n  \"Effect\": \"Allow\",\n  \"Principal\": {\"AWS\": \"arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/assessor-temp/*\"},\n  \"Action\": [\"kms:Decrypt\",\"kms:DescribeKey\"],\n  \"Resource\": \"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01\"\n}\n```\n\nmarta: Looks good. Make sure grant is timeboxed to the 6-hour reading-room window and rotated between retest slots.
elle: Audit logs — we need immutable export. Proposal: ship CloudTrail + application audit logs to a write-once S3 prefix with MFA delete enabled and daily snapshot to Glacier. Retain 90 days for the engagement artifacts.
sam: Where do we store evidence for the assessor to download? Pre-signed URLs?
elle: Prefer pre-signed URLs generated from the write-once prefix only during reading-room windows. Record every presign action in a separate audit stream.
ashley: Also add an ingestion checklist so they can validate our telemetry collection: sample curl command, example event, and a trace id mapping. I'll draft it.
carlos: On the retest: AcmeSec asked for two retest slots within 30 days. We should block calendar windows and an ops oncall for each slot. Suggested windows: 2026-05-20 08:00-12:00 UTC and 2026-05-27 13:00-17:00 UTC.
marta: Tag the retest Jira tickets with staging env snapshot id and the infra git commit used to build it. That way we can prove identical surface.
elaine: Remediation tracker — use the security board (SEC-TRACK) with these fields: vuln id, severity, owner, patch PR, infra diff, evidence upload link, verification checkbox, scheduled retest slot.
sam: Can we automate attaching the audit export link to the ticket?
nashley: Yes — I'll add a webhook that posts S3 presign + CloudTrail snapshot link once evidence is uploaded.
carlos: We should also run a dry-run next Wednesday for the reading-room process. Steps: create ephemeral role, grant KMS decrypt, pre-sign evidence, confirm presign logged, give assessor reading-room access.
marta: Who owns the dry-run? I can take lead but need an infra buddy for the CMK grant and a security reviewer for the policy.
elaine: Marta + Carlos + Ashley. Sam will be oncall for the dry-run in case of infra breakage.
sam: Fine.
deploy-bot: Deployed: feature/ephemeral-roles 3 commits to staging at commit abc123 — smoke tests passed. :white_check_mark:
carlos: One last thing — ensure we scrub PII from logs before packaging evidence. Add a pre-sign hook that runs redaction and outputs a redaction manifest.
ashley: I'll add the manifest to the evidence bundle and include the manifest hash in the ticket.
marta: OK team, I'll create the SEC-TRACK ticket template and fill the first assessment ticket. Dry-run scheduled 2026-05-03 15:00 UTC.
elaine: Great. After dry-run, please paste a short postmortem here: what failed, what took >10m, and whether the KMS grant flow needs tweaks.
sam: Will do.
elaine: Thanks all — keeping this thread as the single source for ops runbook and retest booking. :lock:
